The link path must not exist, and the target must already exist.
Retargeting only changes the link, never moves files. Creating symlinks may require Developer Mode or administrator privileges.

strings.zh: 链接发现直接查询 Everything 当前实例的已有索引，不重建索引。范围取决于该实例的索引设置。
strings.en: Link discovery queries an existing Everything index; no new indexing is performed. Results depend on the selected instance's index settings.

strings.zh: “连接 / 刷新”只更新 Everything 发现的链接列表，不重新统计已有目标大小。“计算当前列表”优先复用永久大小缓存，仅扫描未计算的目标。第二行末尾的“更新”链接强制重算当前实例全部本地非系统目标；右键可重算所选。不会跟随内部重解析点，网络目标暂不统计。
strings.en: Connect / Refresh only refreshes the link list, not cached sizes. Measure list reuses cached sizes and scans unmeasured targets. Update on the statistics line forces recalculation for all local, non-system targets; right-click to recalculate selected items. Nested reparse points are skipped, and network targets are not measured.

strings.zh: 永久缓存：LinkShelf.sizes.json 保存在程序旁，第二行显示创建时间及最近更新时间。目录数据发生变化后请手动更新。LinkShelf.links.json 记录各 Everything 实例上次成功发现的链接；首次运行建立基线，之后新链接以绿色标出。
strings.en: Persistent cache: LinkShelf.sizes.json is saved beside the app. The second line shows creation and last-update times; refresh manually after file changes. LinkShelf.links.json stores the last discovered links for each Everything instance. The first run establishes a baseline; new links are highlighted green thereafter.

strings.zh: C 盘已转出数据：按所有已发现的非系统属性链接计算，与搜索筛选无关；只累计 C: 链接指向其他本地盘的当前逻辑文件大小。相同目标和嵌套目标去重。未计算和部分结果会分别标出；目标不存在的链接列在下方明细，不计入总量或部分/异常数。
strings.en: Data offloaded from C: counts all discovered non-system links independently of search filters. Only C: links targeting other local drives contribute their current logical size. Identical and nested targets are deduplicated. Pending and partial scans are reported separately; missing targets appear in the detail pane and do not affect totals or partial/error counts.

strings.zh: 这是当前数据量估算，不是历史释放空间或物理占用：压缩、稀疏文件、硬链接会造成差异。扫描过程中文件变化也可能影响结果。
strings.en: This is an estimate of current logical data size, not historical space freed or physical disk usage. Compression, sparse files, hard links, and changes during scanning can affect results.

strings.zh: 删除仅删除链接本身；修改指向不移动文件。所有写操作前记录 LinkShelf.operations.jsonl。卷挂载点与带系统属性的链接只读。
strings.en: Delete removes only the link; retargeting does not move data. Every write is logged to LinkShelf.operations.jsonl beforehand. Volume mount points and system-attribute links are read-only.

strings.zh: 普通文件夹迁移请使用同包的 LinkShelfMover.exe；可在资源管理器“发送到”菜单调用，迁移后自动建立目录连接点 /J 或符号链接 /D。涉及重要数据时请备份并退出占用软件，迁移后在 LinkShelf 刷新核对。
strings.en: Use the bundled LinkShelfMover.exe to migrate ordinary folders, optionally launched from Explorer's Send to menu. It creates a directory junction /J or symlink /D after migration. Back up important files and close applications using them; refresh LinkShelf afterward to verify.

目录链接已创建；旧目录备份待清理。
strings.en: Folder link created; original backup needs cleanup.

strings.zh: 迁移结果
已取消，原目录未迁移。
strings.en: Cancelled; original folder was not moved.

strings.zh: 任务已取消。复制用的临时目录会尽力清理。
strings.en: Task cancelled. Temporary copy data will be cleaned up where possible.

strings.zh: 迁移未完成，请查看错误详情。
权限不足

是否以管理员身份重新打开此工具？
会保留原目录和目标路径，重新确认后才开始迁移。
strings.en:
Restart this tool as administrator?
Source, destination and link type will be preserved. You must confirm the move again.

strings.zh: 已请求管理员权限，迁移尚未重新开始。
strings.en: Administrator elevation requested; migration has not restarted yet.

strings.zh: 已取消管理员授权；原目录未迁移。
strings.en: Administrator elevation cancelled; source folder was not moved.

strings.zh: 无法重新以管理员身份启动：
当前已经具有管理员权限，请检查目录 ACL、占用程序及防护软件设置。
strings.en: You already have administrator privileges. Check folder ACLs, open programs and security software.

strings.zh: 检测到中断的迁移
上次中断的目录已恢复：
恢复失败，请保留备份目录：
strings.en: Recovery failed; keep the backup folder:

strings.zh: 检测到旧目录备份尚在，请核实后手工清理：
strings.en: Old source backup remains; inspect and clean up manually:

strings.zh: 提示：上次迁移遗留备份，详情见下方记录。
strings.en: Notice: a backup from a previous migration remains. See the log below.

strings.zh: 重解析数据不完整
仅管理文件夹链接
其他重解析点
重解析头损坏
目标路径数据损坏
链接目标路径过长
strings.en: Link target path is too long

strings.zh: 链接已被其他程序修改，请刷新后重试。
strings.en: Another program modified the link; refresh and retry.

strings.zh: 此项目不可修改。
相对符号链接不能改到另一卷，请新建绝对符号链接。
strings.en: A relative symlink cannot be retargeted to another volume; create an absolute symlink instead.

strings.zh: 修改失败，恢复也失败：{0}。旧关系已记录在操作日志。
strings.en: Change failed and recovery also failed: {0}. The previous relation was saved to the operation log.

strings.zh: 请选择完整的目标路径。
目录连接点要求本地盘符目标，网络路径请使用符号链接。
strings.en: A junction requires a local drive target; use a symlink for network paths.

strings.zh: 目标不能是链接自身或链接内的子目录。
strings.en: The link cannot target itself or a descendant folder.

strings.zh: 目标目录不存在或不可访问。
strings.en: Target folder is missing or inaccessible.

strings.zh: 链接位置必须是本地完整路径。
strings.en: Link location must be a complete local path.

strings.zh: 不能在卷根目录上创建链接。
strings.en: Cannot create a link at a volume root.

strings.zh: 链接的父目录不存在。
strings.en: Link parent folder does not exist.

strings.zh: 已有一个 LinkShelf Mover 正在运行。为了避免两个迁移任务冲突，请先完成前一个任务。
strings.en: Another LinkShelf Mover is running. Finish the first move before starting another.

strings.zh: 每次只能迁移一个目录。请在资源管理器中仅选择一个文件夹。
strings.en: Only one folder can be moved at a time. Select a single folder in File Explorer.

strings.zh: Everything 未接受查询。请确认客户端正在运行，且两边使用相同的权限级别。
strings.en: Everything rejected the query. Ensure it is running and both processes have matching privilege levels.

strings.zh: Everything 返回数据不完整。
Everything 返回数据无效。
候选目录超过十万项，本次结果不完整；请缩小 Everything 索引范围后重试。
strings.en: More than 100,000 candidate folders; results are incomplete. Narrow the Everything index scope and retry.

strings.zh: Everything 字符串偏移无效。
Everything 字符串未终止。
‘发送到’菜单已安装；如需更换程序位置，请先移除后重新安装。
strings.en: Send to menu is already installed. Remove it before reinstalling from a new location.

strings.zh: ‘发送到’菜单已经存在同名项目；请先检查该快捷方式，不会覆盖其他文件。
strings.en: A Send to item with the same name already exists; it will not be overwritten. Inspect the shortcut.

strings.zh: 系统未提供 Windows Script Host 快捷方式组件。
strings.en: Windows Script Host shortcut support is unavailable.

strings.zh: 同名快捷方式不属于 LinkShelf Mover，拒绝删除。
strings.en: This shortcut does not belong to LinkShelf Mover; deletion refused.

strings.zh: 大小缓存超出安全上限
strings.en: Size cache exceeds the safety limit

strings.zh: 大小缓存版本或格式不正确
strings.en: Size cache version or format is invalid

strings.zh: 链接快照超出安全上限
strings.en: Link snapshot exceeds the safety limit

strings.zh: 链接快照版本或格式不正确
strings.en: Link snapshot version or format is invalid

strings.zh: 使用 LinkShelf Mover 迁移
IPC 连接中…
IPC 已连接，等待 Everything 返回结果…
strings.en: IPC connected; waiting for Everything results…

strings.zh: Everything 已返回结果，正在解析…
Everything 返回结果超时，请重试。
strings.en: Timed out waiting for Everything results. Please retry.

strings.zh: IPC 连接失败，请检查 Everything 状态及权限。
strings.en: IPC connection failed. Check Everything and process permissions.

strings.zh: IPC 连接失败：未发现 Everything 客户端。
strings.en: IPC connection failed: Everything client not found.
